content: {"summary":"Customers report that Xbox One X struggles with HDR and 4K playback, citing issues with HDMI 2.0 compatibility and missing HDR recognition on 1080p monitors [#tk_1465811] [#tk_2425123]. Many users experience letterboxing and lack of aspect‑ratio controls in the Blu‑ray app, while artwork quality on the home screen is poor [#tk_2858568] [#tk_2276688]. Some complain that 4K Blu‑ray discs play only on One S, suggesting a software glitch or hardware limitation [#tk_2801089]. Overall, the feedback highlights a need for firmware updates to support 4K 10‑bit color and improve Blu‑ray app functionality [#tk_556853]"}
